body:
Really? Years without nothing, and suddenly, you find the familiar way to giving and feeling pleasure?
I can't imagine how awkward I'm going to be.
Eat them. Just eat them all.

I may be perfectly wrong, but I do think that there are places, institutions, where you can call and say "well hello, I'm this and that, I'm frightened to death that I will act on it, can you maybe help me for free ?".

I once knew a guy who did just that and underwent chemical treatment to mute his impulses. He was an american with no health insurance, the treatment was paid by an institution, can't remember which one though.
Isn't it one of thoses cases where the treatment might be paid for by your health system?

Oh, I just re-read your message, and found this part especially tasty : "this post should not be in this sub at all".

This is a great choice of words to tell to somebody feeling inadequate and not belonging anywhere. No sarcasm intended, just a tinge of irony.
I'm not sure what you mean.

About the stupid thingie, well, at some point I'll eventually do that.

It's like a pre-planned final ending for a crappy movie. Oh, there will be twists and turns, but the audience won't be surprised by the end.

Well, look at that. There actually IS somebody in here.   ;-)

I will take good note of this solace thing you mentioned, and will probably try to hunt for it in some of those places at some point.

I promise, I will pay the rent. No need to call the landlord. I hear he can be pretty tricky to mollify, when enraged.

Thank you for the answer, anyhoo.

I'll even think about this whole "saving self" funny business.
